Match.description: A match as written, before checking that it selects on something.

app_id.description:
Pattern for the application identifier, such as `firefox` or
`org.gnome.*`. `*` stands for any run of characters.

title.description: Pattern for the window title. `*` stands for any run of characters.

Rule.description: What to do with a new window that matches.

decorations.description: Draw a titlebar and border around the window, or not.

fullscreen.description: Open the window fullscreen, or not.

match.description: Which windows the rule applies to.

maximized.description: Open the window maximized, or not.

private.description:
Leave the window blank in any picture taken of the screen, or not.
Unlike the others this holds for as long as the window matches,
not only when it opens: a title that comes to match hides it.

workspace.description: Open the window on the workspace with this number.

rules.description:
Rules applied to new windows. Every matching rule applies, in order,
so a later rule overrides an earlier one.
